notes.title: -- | Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House | Out Now | --
notes.notes: [h2]Released! Unleashed! Let Loose! Out! Out right now![/h2][p]We made it! [b]Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House is out![/b] We cannot wait for you to play![/p][p][/p][p]We've got 15 levels.[/p][p]We've got Rolo, Weenie, Biff and Shep with their stories to tell.[/p][p]We've got literally [i]hundreds [/i]of dogs to find.[/p][p]We've got [i]over a hundred [/i]items to find. They're scatted all over the place (those pesky mutts!).[/p][p]We've got music, we've got a whistle, we've got a bunch of silly dog sounds.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh, don't you worry - there's loads of stuff, we've got you covered![/p][p][/p][p]Plus, we won't be stopping here, we've got plans for the future! Plans. They are afoot.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime; we want your screenshots, we want your favourite mutts, we want to see photos of your dogs, we want to put your dogs [i]in the game[/i], we want competitions, with prizes, and we want stickers![/p][p][/p][p]Mostly, we want [b]your feedback[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Let us know how we're doing, let us know what you want. Help us shape the future of Hidden Dogs! [/p][p]Woof.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/7d934a7915ec5ac240523289f94183fb7f8537a8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House | Releasing Tomorrow!
notes.notes: [p]Dog fans! We're so, so close now... one day from release! Oh, you want content, eh? [/p][p][/p][p]Well here we go - the [b]Greenhouse[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]The Greenhouse is at the back of Rolo's garden.[/p][p]It was once a hive of activity, hosting a historic hero of horticulture.[/p][p]These days, gardening is hard on the knees, so the local plant life has taken over...[/p][p]Oh, and not just plants... many, many Hidden Dogs! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/37a7c09ae86dac1bdfc5750218bae0d71b3fd37a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.notes: [p]5 days until we release! Aghh! So exciting![/p][p][/p][p]We're putting the final touches to the game. Polish. Polish. Polish.[/p][p][/p][p]Our programmer is finessing, tweaking and lightly perspiring.[/p][p]Our QA tester is poking and prodding the last few bugs.[/p][p]Our marketing team is putting together a visual feast for the eyes![/p][p] [/p][p]Our art department are on the beach.
